ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1, The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B1-1,
Neighborhood Shopping District; B3-1, Community Shopping District; C1-1,
Neighborhood Comniercial District; and C1-2, Neighborhood Commercial District,
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 28-F and Map No. 30-F in the area bound

by:

West 118" Street; the alley next east of and parallel to South Halsted Street; West 118m
Place; a line 100 feet west of and parallel to South Emerald Avenue; the alley next north
of and parallel to West 119" Street; South Normal Avenue; the alley next north of and
parallel to West 119" Street; a line 131.7 feet east of and parallel to South Normal
Avenue; West 119 Street; South Eggleston Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel
to West 119" Street; South Princeton Avenue; West 119" Street; South Stewart Avenue;
the alley next south of and parallel to West 119" Street; South Normal Avenue; West
119" Street; a line 81.58 feet east of and parallel to South Pamell Avenue; the alley next
south of and parallei to West 119" Street; South Emerald Avenue; West 119" Street;
and South Halsted Street,

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
